fact: The Council of Ministers of 22 April 2026 adopted a draft ordinance on civil status to clarify the national civil register and the national population register, and decrees creating the ANEI agency, citing the lack of interoperability between existing registers as what had held back a national identification system.
title: Au Conseil des Ministres : Le Gouvernement adopte plusieurs projets de textes à caractères juridique, social, sécuritaire et économique
